### Don't Bother Me with Details!
Author: Katherine Britton
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/don-t-bother-me-with-details-crosswalk-the-devotional-march-24-2011.html
Passage: Joshua 11:23
Points:
- Readers often overlook biblical lists of borders and tribal allotments as uninteresting trivia.
- These specific distributions represented the fulfillment of a promise God made to Abraham six centuries earlier.
- God orchestrates sweeping redemptive history without ever losing sight of the smallest details.
- The recording of concrete, tedious details proves that God accomplishes everything He promises.
- Believers can find encouragement knowing God cares for and directs the routine details of daily life.
